items.title: 63475_Arnett Cobb oral history interview
items.q: Joe Morris did the Chop-Chop, if you remember, on the flip side of Hamp's Boogie Woogie.

ctx.x: Well, what I want you to do on that is tell a little bit more about that Lionel Hampton band. You know, that was an important band at that time. And I mean who did most of the arranging. Things like that, you see.

Well, Milton Buckner was one of the main arrangers in the band. He did most of it. Al Hayes did a couple of tunes in the band. Joe Morris did the Chop-Chop, if you remember, on the flip side of Hamp's Boogie Woogie.
